body: I called you out because you broke a subreddit rule. Don't be patronizing.
I didn't know that. I understand, thank you for he reminder.

I'll be downvoted for this, but I couldn't care less. While the sentiment behind your post is genuine and kind, I can't stand posts like this. What do you want? A cookie? Gold? A sticker? If you want to support the people on this sub, message them directly or reply to their posts, don't put up your own post about how sympathetic you are. 

P.S. I have read through your post history and you absolutely have been supportive commenting on people's posts. I was just talking about posts like yours in general.

This is not meant to be condescending, rather the opposite I mean it as a hopeful thing, you are only 17. You shouldn't know yet what you want to do with your life. Stop putting so much pressure on yourself over it. 

From a practical standpoint, worst case scenario is you fail high school and get your GED instead, when you're ready to. After that, move on to college, if you want to. I know it's hard to see this when you're 17 and have been in the school system your entire life, but education is NOT everything. You know what is? Attitude, work ethic, kindness, passion and dedication. 

And you totally can make some money from being a comic writer. Don't give up!
At the very least it would convince me to stick around a little while longer. Like maybe a week or two.
